# BTicino C300X Native Agent Integration v0.6.0

Feature release focused on the doorbell camera live view and native-agent
stability.

## Highlights

- Updates the native C300X device agent to `0.6.0`.
- Adds a brand-new app-like doorbell streaming path for the on-demand live
  view.
- Opens the Home Assistant camera as video-only by default so the frontend can
  autoplay the live view. Interactive media sessions can still request audio
  and talkback.
- Recovers cleanly after failed or interrupted media sessions.

## Update note

After updating the Home Assistant integration, run the device-agent update
Repair if Home Assistant offers it. The integration and native agent should both
report `0.6.0` after the update has completed and the integration has reloaded.

## Notes

- This release keeps the Home Assistant minimum version at `2026.5.0`.
- The agent API remains local HTTP on the trusted LAN. Keep browser/front-end
  access on HTTPS when using microphone/talkback features.
